overview.en: Pithecheirops otion is a little-known murid rodent from Sabah, Malaysian Borneo, and the sole described species of its genus.
overview.fr: Pithecheirops otion est un rongeur muridé peu connu de Sabah, dans le Bornéo malaisien, et la seule espèce décrite de son genre.

identification.en: It was originally described from a single specimen, and its distinguishing anatomy includes features of the middle-ear region and skull.
identification.fr: L’espèce a été décrite à l’origine à partir d’un seul spécimen ; des caractères distinctifs concernent l’oreille moyenne et le crâne.

habitat.en: The sole museum specimen came from Danum Valley; later sightings there suggest the species persists.
habitat.fr: Le seul spécimen de musée provenait de la vallée de Danum ; des observations ultérieures suggèrent que l’espèce s’y maintient.

diet.fr: Son régime alimentaire naturel reste inconnu.

behavior.en: The original account described it as arboreal, but its daily habits remain largely unknown.
behavior.fr: La description initiale la présente comme arboricole, mais ses habitudes restent largement inconnues.

ecology.en: Genetic evidence places Pithecheirops as the sister genus of Pithecheir.
ecology.fr: Les données génétiques placent Pithecheirops comme genre frère de Pithecheir.

conservation.en: Few records leave its abundance and conservation needs uncertain.
conservation.fr: Le faible nombre d’observations laisse son abondance et ses besoins de conservation incertains.

title.en: A new genus and species of rat from Borneo — Proceedings of the Biological Society of Washington
title.fr: Nouveau genre et nouvelle espèce de rat de Bornéo — Proceedings of the Biological Society of Washington

facts: Emmons described Pithecheirops otion as a new genus and species of arboreal rat from Sabah and compared it with Pithecheir; diagnostic morphology centers on skull and auditory-region traits.

facts: A recent genetic study links Pithecheirops closely with Pithecheir.

title.fr: Pithecheirops otion Emmons, 1993 — Musée national d’histoire naturelle Smithsonian

facts: The Smithsonian specimen database records the holotype from Danum Valley Field Centre in Sabah and dates its collection to 1991.

uncertainties: Most aspects of this rodent’s ecology remain poorly documented; an absence of observations does not establish absence of a behavior or threat.
The genomic relationship is at genus level and does not imply that Pithecheir and Pithecheirops are species-level cousins.
review_note: The entry stays brief because the species is known from few records; newer genetic work clarifies its relationship to Pithecheir.
